subject: POC plan / success criteria and re-baseline request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Next steps & proposed POC plan

Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for Acme's search reranking pipeline and cost/latency tradeoffs for ranked results at 512 token context.
- Success criteria (initial):
  - Mean latency (p95) < 250ms for single-query reranking during a 100 qps sustained stage load;
  - >= 12% lift in NDCG@10 on your labeled dev set vs current baseline;
  - No data leaves your VPC during the POC and logs retention limited to 30 days.
- Proposed POC scope & timeline:
  - Week 0 (this week): environment access + sample dataset ingestion (Acme to share);
  - Week 1-2: integration and run baseline tests;
  - Week 3: quality evaluation + tuning;
  - Week 4: final report and recommendation.

I've attached a one-page POC plan (ACME-POC-plan-20260627.pdf) with ownership and checkpoints. Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether we should include an evaluation of a reranking-only flow or add a combined rerank+generate scenario?

Next steps: if you confirm, we can kick off environment setup Monday and schedule a technical onboarding.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACME-POC-plan-20260627.pdf (1 page PDF — POC scope, owners, timeline)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Next steps & proposed POC plan

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming acceptance of the proposed success criteria with one ask: can we add a secondary track to evaluate a lightweight intent classification model for intent-level filtering upstream of reranking? It's lower priority but would help product decide whether to invest in a two-stage pipeline.

Also confirming Acme will share a 50k sample of labeled logs (dev set) by Tuesday. Environment access: we'll provide a service account and a small S3 bucket (read-only) for the dataset.

If adding intent classification changes timeline materially, let us know. Otherwise we are happy to run both tracks in parallel if feasible.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Search & Relevance, Acme Corp
alex.turner@acme.com | +1 212-555-4432

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Next steps & proposed POC plan

Alex — great, thanks for the confirmation and the extra ask. Short answer: we can run a parallel lightweight intent classification evaluation without blocking the main reranking track. Impact/notes:

- Work to add intent track: ~2 engineer-days (setup + one evaluation), will use same dataset with additional labels (intent tag) if available; otherwise we can do weak labeling for first pass.
- Timeline impact: parallel track keeps the 4-week end date, but Week 2 milestone will include the first intent classification results.
- Success criteria for intent: intent classification accuracy >= 85% on the dev set or a precision@k threshold you prefer. Please confirm which metric you care about.

I've attached the POC plan with an added intent-track appendix and updated ownership. Please review and sign off so we can schedule onboarding Monday.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment: ACME-POC-plan-20260627.pdf (updated: intent appendix)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Next steps & proposed POC plan

Marissa / team — quick update from our side after starting ingestion: the initial reranking signals look promising but the product team pushed back and asked us to add an additional use case mid-POC: intent classification should be evaluated as a gating step for an experimental personalization feature. They want a clear pass/fail for the intent gating decision as part of the POC report.

Concrete asks:
- Can Redwood add intent gating success criteria that map to a binary pass/fail we can use for the feature toggle (e.g., >= 90% precision on top-intent)?
- If we add this gating requirement, how does it affect the current timeline and resource allocation?

We know this mid-trial change is late — happy to discuss tradeoffs. We need the re-baselined plan and a sign-off so the product council can approve continued work.

—Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: REBASELINE request — intent gating added mid-POC

Alex — understood and thanks for the heads up. We've scoped the impact and attached a short re-baseline doc (20260715-poc-rebaseline.pdf) but summarizing here: 

- New gating success criteria (intent): precision@1 >= 90% on your labeled gating set; recall should be measured but precision is the gating metric.
- Resource impact: Add 1 engineer (Redwood SE) for 3 business days to build/validate the intent model and wiring; Dev (your side) to supply intent labels or accept weak labeling for the first pass.
- Timeline impact: 1-week extension to the POC end date (new end date = +7 days). We keep the interim checkpoints but move final report from Week 4 to Week 5.
- Cost: no additional Redwood license fees for the POC; we will allocate the extra engineering time under existing trial terms.

Please review the attached re-baseline PDF and reply with "ACCEPT" to confirm. Once we have sign-off I'll route a change summary to our delivery team and schedule the extra SE time.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment: 20260715-poc-rebaseline.pdf (2 pages — gating criteria, timeline, owners)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: REBASELINE request — intent gating added mid-POC

Looping in briefly to confirm internal availability. We have a SE available to start on Monday 2026-07-19 for up to 3 days for the intent work. Marissa — I'll unblock the calendar and make sure the SE has the dataset access notes. Alex — once you reply with ACCEPT and provide either labeled intent data or confirmation to proceed with weak labels, we will slot the work.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
